ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(OwnerId), OR( AND( $Profile.Name = "System Administrator", ISBLANK(TEXT(LeadSource)) ), AND( $Profile.Name = "Contract Manager", OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(LeadSource)), ISBLANK(Country__c) ) ), AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "Contract Manager", OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(LeadSource)), ISBLANK(Country__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(NumberOfEmployees)) ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot change the Lead Owner unless required fields are filled in (Country / Lead Source / No. of Employees, depending on profile).
